metadata.design: 12 paired blocks per workload; rotate 3 candidates and reverse each second group of 3; fresh processes; 5ms doubling warmup then one timed batch; timer covers indirect call/black_box/checksum, not allocation/oracle/startup/teardown. Resident small buffers only. Select full-scan lowest median only if all paired competitor/winner ratios have second-smallest >1.02 (interval second..eleventh; 99.365% marginal iid sign interval, no familywise claim). early is security-rejected control; xor is uncertified teaching code; no timing-security certification.
